definitions.full: H7588. shaon שָׁאוֺן noun masculine Hosea 10:14 roar (of waters, etc.), din, crash, uproar ; — absolute ׳שׁ 10:14 +; construct שְׁאוֺן Isa 13:4 +; suffix שְׁאוֺנָהּ 5:14 ; — 1 roar of water (waves), Isa 17:12 (|| הָמָה ), simile of noise of invading host, so 17:13 , but strike out Du Che Hpt Marti, as doublet; roar of this host 17:12 (|| הָמוֺן ), compare קוֺלָם שְׁאוֺן Jer 51:55 of waves also Psa 65:8 (twice in verse); of din , or crash of battle Amos 2:2 ; Hosea 10:14 ; Psa 74:23 ; שׁ ׳בְּנֵי Jer 48:45 (i. e. warriors); of battle in which ׳י beats down his foes 25:31 , compare Isa 66:6 ; of gathering hosts 13:4 ; זָרִים 25:3 (Du Marti, plausibly, זְדִים גְּאוֺן , as 13:11 ); read ׳שׁ also probably (for שַׁאֲנָן , q. v.) 2Kin 19:28 = Isa 37:29 ; in mocking appell. of Pharaoh (Necho), Jer 46:17 ׳מּ ( ᵑ9 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 ) שֵׁם קִרְאוּ call ye the name of Phoenician a crash . 2 uproar of revellers Isa 5:14 ; 24:8 . — שׁ ׳בּוֺר Psa 40:3 , pit of roaring (of waters? figurative, compare מַעֲמַקֵּימַֿיִם 69:3 , where also || יָוִן ); Thes and others of destruction (see √ 2 ), but against usage of שָׁאוֺן ; > Du proposes שָׁוְא בּוֺר (compare שָׁוְא נָפַת Isa 30:28 ).
